title: Aligned with Whom? Direct and social goals for AI systems
reasoning: The paper is a conceptual analysis of AI alignment through the lens of ethics and social welfare economics. It explicitly discusses and evaluates ethical frameworks such as utilitarianism, Rawlsian (maximin) principles, and deontological considerations as methods for defining 'social alignment' in AI systems. It also discusses the role of religion and morals in shaping human agency and alignment in society.
